def path_trace(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])

    ends=[p for p in cells if len(nb(p))==1]

    # walk from one end greedily (spiral has no branches ideally)
    deg={p:len(nb(p)) for p in cells}
    print('branch cells:',[p for p in cells if deg[p]>2])
    return cells,ends

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seed=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==3]
    assert len(seed)==1
    sr,sc=seed[0]
    k=2
    while True:
        r0,r1,c0,c1=sr-k,sr+k,sc-k,sc+k
        if r1<0 or r0>=h or c1<0 or c0>=w: break
        gap=(r0,c0+1); p=(r0,c0+2)
        dirs=[(0,1),(1,0),(0,-1),(-1,0)]  # clockwise sides
        stopped=False
        cur=p
        for _ in range(8*k-1):  # cells in ring minus gap
            if not(0<=cur[0]<h and 0<=cur[1]<w):
                # move along ring perimeter even if outside
                pass
            else:
                if g[cur[0]][cur[1]]==2: stopped=True; break
                out[cur[0]][cur[1]]=3
            # next cell clockwise around ring
            if cur[0]==r0 and cur[1]<c1: d=(0,1)
            elif cur[1]==c1 and cur[0]<r1: d=(1,0)
            elif cur[0]==r1 and cur[1]>c0: d=(0,-1)
            else: d=(-1,0)
            cur=(cur[0]+d[0],cur[1]+d[1])
        if stopped: break
        k+=2
    return out
